scene.ofreeRecent: a beach club of white daybeds and parasols on the sand — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a sunlit white marble temple; a cinema lobby with a popcorn counter; a small open pavilion with upturned eaves perched on a sheer mountain cliff above a sea of clouds; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks; a sunny concrete skate park of smooth bowls and ramps; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights; a deep indoor diving pool with a large glass observation window set into its side wall — swimming freestyle at an easy pace; the curved black-tiled roof ridge of a great hall under a huge full moon — plays a long bamboo xiao flute with a red tassel; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — plays a violin and its bow; a dark jellyfish room — standing; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — lying on her left side

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus.
